novella.title: Hic Non Sunt Dracones
novella.tagline: London, 1897. The age of exploration is dying.
description: St. James Society, a place where discovery is only measured in profit. But Major Jason Havelock, a veteran of debatable exploits and absolute conviction, refuses to live in a world without wonder.
Havelock ignites the quest for a lost city deep in the Brazilian wilderness. His plan is simple. Reality couldn't be further from it.
The entrance to that lost city lies at the heart of a brutal civil war that has been raging for almost a year. The Brazilian Army is preparing to level the rebel stronghold once and for all.
To reach their objective, Havelock's crew must evade blockades, ambushes, and dive head first into battlefield.
At the dawn of industrial warfare, one old soldier is chasing a whisper from the blank spaces of our maps.
<strong>The last charge of the light brigade is about to begin.
Not a prequel. Not a sequel. Just a story. My own take on classical adventure, and an invitation to think about what comes next.
